verdict.reason: The source gives the neighbors' 2024 tax revenue ($909,000 in Power and $639,000 in Bingham) and says Hough believes renewables would bring money in. It never says the ban is 'starving' the county's budget. It only says the county and Downey could miss out on future revenue if the ban continues, and the strongest framing is Hough's op-ed warning that counties with bans 'will watch the projects — and the money — go elsewhere.'
